thread:
samir: Heads up — ACME reported being billed twice for the same sessions. Their invoice shows token lines from both eu-west and us-central for overlapping timestamps. Anyone seen cross-region dup-counting recently?

maria: ugh. do you have a sample request id or time window?

samir: sent DM with customer id + sample req_id: r_0a9f3c. Seen in router logs: two distinct backend endpoints accepted the same request within 300ms.

kevin: that sounds like the routing retry logic + proxy sticky hash mismatch. if a retry goes to a different region the metering agent emits a separate billing event. we only dedupe by idempotency_key in the billing pipeline, and the proxy sometimes strips it.

olivia: can we generate a canonical "billing_fingerprint" before routing that survives retries? e.g. sha256(session_id + model + prompt_prefix) and attach as x-billing-fingerprint header. cheap and idempotent.

ana: typo: my name is ana btw :) we already attach X-Request-ID but upstream LB rewrites for some customers (cloudfront variation). fingerprinting at edge is better.

samir: agreed. short-term mitigation: hold off emitting billing events for 2s after first accept if another event with same request_id/fingerprint appears. would that cause perceptible lag?

kevin: 2s window seems ok for most users, but risk undercount during real parallel requests. better: attach a bool "retry_hint" from router -> billing agent and route retries to the same metering shard.

maria: for reconciliation we can run dedupe SQL and apply credits now. query I used last night:

```
SELECT customer_id, request_id, count(*) as events, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM billing_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2023-12-17T10:00:00Z' AND '2023-12-17T10:10:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id, request_id
HAVING count(*) > 1;
```

kevin: nice. we should join that with router traces to see if duplicates correlate with route changes. I suspect policy:route-by-latency + retry-on-5xx yields cross-region handoff.

olivia: ops note: adding X-Billing-Fingerprint at edge requires a tiny change in the CDN and our api-proxy. I sketched the code:

```
fingerprint = sha256( session_id + "|" + model + "|" + substr(prompt,0,200) )
set_header("x-billing-fingerprint", fingerprint)
```

ana: small implementation snag: prompt is sometimes huge (>8k). we should use a prefix and length normalization to avoid different values for the same logical prompt (e.g., trailing context).

sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for api-proxy-v2 to 10% traffic (includes x-billing-fingerprint).

samir: awesome. for customer impact: ACME already got a credit entry in invoices? billing-bot?

billing-bot: Automated action: created credit 1200 token-equivalent for customer ACME (reason: duplicate billing reconciliation). Credit ID: CR-20231217-6543.

maria: I'll run a backfill job to mark duplicate events as reconciled and exclude them from invoice join. plan: run dedupe -> create credits -> audit report. estimated run time ~7m for the affected window.

kevin: we should also add a console flag under Console -> Billing -> Experimental: "Show billing fingerprints" and an API to download fingerprints for a timeframe. helps support and audits. UX request to product? @olivia can you file a ticket?

olivia: filing now. will include schema: fingerprint, request_id, model, tokens, route, ts.

samir: long term: update router policy to prefer sticky routing on retries and backoff jitter to reduce cross-region failover noise. also update metering agent to dedupe on x-billing-fingerprint first, then request_id.

ana: note for implementation: add migration to anonymize fingerprint in audit logs (hash only) to avoid storing raw prompt data.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll post the reconciliation CSV in #eng-platform when job completes. :thumbsup:

kevin: add to next retro — routing policies + billing implications.

sre-bot: incident-note: partial billing duplication affecting ~12 customers between 2023-12-17T09:58 and 2023-12-17T10:12 UTC. mitigation: credits issued for known duplicates, canary of fingerprint header deployed to 10% traffic.

samir: closing loop: ACME confirmed credit applied and invoice adjusted. leaving ticket open until full rollout and one-week stability window. :raised_hands:
